How Keystill scores typing

What counts as a word?

Keystill counts five correctly matched characters as one standard word. Spaces, capitals and punctuation count when they match the passage at the same position. The timer starts with your first typed character.

For example, 450 correct characters in three minutes gives 450 ÷ 5 ÷ 3 = 30 WPM. A 40 WPM target over the same time takes 600 correct characters. Live speed fluctuates most in the opening seconds.

Why can a corrected mistake still affect accuracy?

Speed uses the text currently in the box. Accuracy uses character attempts. If you enter ten characters, mistype one, delete it and type the right one, ten of eleven attempts were correct. Your accuracy rounds to 91%. Backspace itself is not a character attempt.

Use your next minute well

If you miss commas or capitals, choose Punctuation. If digits interrupt your rhythm, try Numbers & symbols. After a round with errors, choose Practice missed words to repeat words drawn from that session for one minute. Then return to the same passage category and test duration for a fair comparison.

A downloaded result records a personal practice session. Employers and schools set their own testing and verification requirements.
